body.message:
Thank you for your payment.

Please find below the payment breakdown for your reference:

Total amount received: AED 7,500

AED 500 – Security deposit paid via payment link
AED 500 – Security deposit paid via payment link
AED 2,000 – Rent paid via bank transfer
AED 3,500 – Rent Paid via payment link

Please note that the AED 3,500 paid via the payment link will be considered as rent. As the payment link carries a 3.1% card processing fee, the net amount received toward the rent is AED 3,391.50.

Therefore:

Pending rent amount: AED 609.50
Pending security deposit: AED 500

Total pending amount: AED 1,109.50

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
